text.p: Tallinna Kaubamaja is to propose the issue of 3.4 million shares at its shareholder meeting, which will double the company's share capital to 67.8 million kroons, the company said on Tuesday.

The board will propose at the shareholder meeing on Saturday to assign 1.4 million kroons to reserves and will propose dividends to shareholders of 8.65 million kroons or 2.55 kroons per one 10-kroon face value share.
"The bonus share issue will increase the reliability of Tallinna Kaubamaja and makes the shares more accessible for small investors," the company said in its statement.
The Kaubamaja board proposes to reinvest 20.2 million kroons from the total net profit of 28.8 million kroons.
